summary: The periodic remote-interval poll is gated on a cheap root ETag check, so a folder with no remote changes is not re-scanned every interval.
changelog: A root ETag check (single PROPFIND Depth: 0) runs before a pure periodic remote-interval reconciliation; if the ETag is unchanged, the full nextcloudcmd scan is skipped instead of re-discovering the whole tree (issue #189).
Manual, inotify, startup, push, resume and recovery runs always reconcile - only the periodic interval benefits from the gate.
